visible_text: 決まったことを待っています...
やることを待っています...
まだ発話がありません。
この会議について聞く

answers.q1: Mostly ONE application surface, but the black control bar at the top (with play/pause/chat/fullscreen/record buttons) feels slightly detached—like a floating overlay. The left panel (meeting notes) and right panel (transcription/translation/subtitles) read as integrated dashboard sections.
answers.q2: Yes, clearly. Acting on a meeting labeled '23:32 の会議' (11:32 PM meeting), currently recording (status shows 00:02 elapsed), and listening to meeting audio. The source is live audio capture from the meeting participants.
answers.q3: Currently recording and passively listening to capture meeting content. Waiting for participants to speak (indicated by 'まだ発話がありません'—no speech yet). Waiting to extract and display 'decided things' and 'things to do' as the meeting progresses. App is in initial listening state.
answers.q4: The meeting identifier (23:32 の会議) and recording status/elapsed time (録音中 00:02). These tell you at a glance what's being recorded and how long it's been running.
answers.q5: The right panel (Transcription/Translation/Subtitles tabs) is mostly empty, creating visual imbalance and unclear purpose to first-time user. The bottom 'AIが見ている資料' (Materials AI is watching) is vague and disconnected—what materials? The waiting status messages on the left feel redundant given the 'no speech yet' message on the right. The multiple action buttons at bottom-right (Summary/Cost/Decisions/Actions) lack clear hierarchy or explanation of what each does.

weaknesses.what: The black floating control bar at top feels detached from the main interface—reads like a separate floating widget rather than integrated toolbar
weaknesses.fix: Anchor the control bar as part of the window chrome or window header, or visually integrate it with the main content area

weaknesses.what: Right panel (Transcription/Translation/Subtitles tabs) is mostly empty, creating visual dead space and unclear purpose on first viewing
weaknesses.fix: Either show placeholder content explaining what will appear here, or collapse/hide the panel until transcription begins

weaknesses.what: Bottom element 'AIが見ている資料' (Materials AI is watching) is vague and unexplained—materials from where? What purpose does this serve?
weaknesses.fix: Clarify this section's purpose with a label or remove it if not essential to core function

weaknesses.what: Multiple waiting/placeholder messages on left panel ('待っています' appearing twice) plus 'まだ発話がありません' on right create redundancy
weaknesses.fix: Consolidate into a single clear initial state message, or show actual content placeholders

weaknesses.what: Four action buttons at bottom-right (Real-time summary / Cost / Decisions / Actions) lack visual priority or explanation
weaknesses.fix: Add brief labels or tooltips; differentiate primary actions from secondary; consider grouping or reordering
